Bouquet of Piranha Plants

Earn the Bouquet of Piranha Plants pin by completing the Lionet collection, or by chance from being one of the first six to complete a Pingo Scavenger Hunt. There will be one of each 6 pins available randomly given out for the first 6 people to present a completed game card
